description: This PHP class defines a database migration script for the OrangeHRM system, particularly for version 5.6.0. It includes logic for updating language strings, managing database schema changes, and handling third-party authentication provider configurations.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Handles database schema and data migration for version 5.6.0 of OrangeHRM, including language string updates, schema modifications, and OpenID provider configurations.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the migration operations, including language string updates, schema modifications, and data insertions.

methods.name: updateLangStringVersion
methods.description: Updates the version of language strings in the database.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of LangStringHelper.

methods.name: removeOpenIdProviders
methods.description: Removes or updates OpenID providers based on certain conditions.

methods.name: changeGoogleProviderURL
methods.description: Updates the provider URL for Google OpenID providers.

methods.name: deleteLangStringTranslationByLangStringUnitId
methods.description: Deletes translation entries for a specific language string unit ID and group ID.
